commit.message:
common : let -draft set -ot, --override-kv and -gfm when the target has them (#2562)

* common : let -draft set -ot, --override-kv and -gfm when the target has them

The draft params start as a copy of the target params, whose override
lists already end with their terminator. Entries from -draft "<args>"
landed after it and the loader never saw them. Drop the copied
terminators before parsing the draft args.

* common : clear the MTP draft placement before parsing -draft
